    Brick-continuity, the seven pointwise implications, and finite-field growth #

    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.brickContinuous_iff_exists_generic_right_brick (k R : Type u) [Field k] [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] :
    (∃ (r : ℕ), 0 < r ∧ (brickClassesOfEndolength k r).Infinite) ↔ ∃ (M : ModuleCat Rᵐᵒᵖ), IsGenericBrick k M
    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.seven_pointwise_implications (k R : Type u) [Field k] [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] :
    let C := FGModuleCat Rᵐᵒᵖ; have conclusion := brickClasses.Finite; have demonet := IsEFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ → conclusion; (demonet ↔ (∀ (s : Set (CategoryTheory.Skeleton C)), IsSemibrick s → s.Finite) → conclusion) ∧ (demonet ↔ (∀ (s : Set (CategoryTheory.Skeleton C)), IsSemibrick s → s.Finite → s.ncard = (simpleIsomorphismClasses Rᵐᵒᵖ).ncard → s = simpleIsomorphismClasses Rᵐᵒᵖ) → conclusion) ∧ (demonet ↔ (∀ (r : ℕ), 0 < r → (brickClassesOfEndolength k r).Finite) → conclusion) ∧ (demonet ↔ (¬∃ (M : ModuleCat Rᵐᵒᵖ), IsGenericBrick k M) → conclusion) ∧ (demonet ↔ (∀ (g : ProjectiveClass Rᵐᵒᵖ) (r : ℕ), 0 < r → (stableClassesOfEndolength k ((projectiveClassWeight k) g) r).Finite) → conclusion) ∧ (demonet ↔ (∀ (W : CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty C), IsWideClass W → FunctoriallyFinite W) → conclusion)

    For a fixed algebra all seven hypotheses in the introduction yield equivalent implications to brick-finiteness.

    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.finiteField_exponential_bricks_by_dimension (k R : Type u) [Field k] [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [Finite k] (h : ¬IsEFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ) :
    ∃ (c : ℝ) (m₀ : ℕ), 0 < c ∧ ∀ m ≥ m₀, ∃ (s : Finset (CategoryTheory.Skeleton (FGModuleCat Rᵐᵒᵖ))), Real.exp (c * ↑m) ≤ ↑s.card ∧ ∀ x ∈ s, ∃ (M : FGModuleCat Rᵐᵒᵖ), CategoryTheory.toSkeleton M = x ∧ IsBrick M ∧ Module.finrank k ↑M.obj ≤ m
